findings.text: blocking: the evidence log the done_when and manifest name is gitignored (*.log, .gitignore:119) and was never force-added, so it is absent from commit 56ee52a8d and lives only in the worktree; after the coordinator merges, the run's named evidence is unreadable and the record cannot be read against its log.

follow-on: the cited log href "/nova/../docs/evidence/replan-2026-09-24/fast-lane/dependency-change.log" normalises to /docs/evidence/..., outside the /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/nova/docs mount served at /nova, so the link 404s in the served SPA; the project-absolute form is /nova/evidence/replan-2026-09-24/fast-lane/dependency-change.log.

follow-on: timeout = 300 is a global default applied to the curated slow lane as well as the fast lane, and the plan's section 4 context names slow tests as numerical sweeps and JAX kernels that legitimately run for minutes, so a slow test can be killed for its runtime rather than its correctness; the node's own gate (uv lock --check) never exercises the bound.
